cases.text: Hi, I'm Mark from Mark Williams Financial Planning, FSP 00000. On our call I'll ask a few questions and tell you plainly where you stand. There's nothing to buy and no pressure. Thirty minutes is usually all it takes. Looking forward to {day}.
